preconditions.description: The input contains exactly N+1 lines: the first line is N, followed by N lines of missile data.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t <= 100000 and 0 <= f <= 100000 for t, f in missiles)
preconditions.description: All missile times and frequencies are within the specified bounds [0, 100000].

preconditions.expression: all(missiles[i][0] <= missiles[i+1][0] for i in range(len(missiles)-1))
preconditions.description: The input missiles are sorted by arrival time in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of simultaneous missiles with the same frequency at any specific time, where counts maps each (time, frequency) pair to the number of missiles arriving at that time with that frequency.
The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of hackerX missiles required.
